syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Kossel-Lewis, lattice enthalpy, Fajan's rule, dipole moment
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Kossel-Lewis approach to chemical bond formation, the concept of ionic and covalent bonds. Ionic Bonding: Formation of ionic bonds, factors affecting the formation of ionic bonds; calculation of lattice enthalpy. Covalent Bonding: Concept of electronegativity, Fajan’s rule, dipole moment

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: VSEPR theory, Valence Bond Theory, hybridization, resonance
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Valence Shell Electron Pair Repulsion (VSEPR) theory and shapes of simple molecules. Quantum mechanical approach to covalent bonding: Valence bond theory - its important features, the concept of hybridization involving s, p and d orbitals, resonance

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: LCAO, bond order, bond energy, homonuclear diatomics, hydrogen bonding
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Molecular Orbital Theory - Its important features, LCAOs, types of molecular orbitals (bonding, antibonding), sigma and pi-bonds, molecular orbital electronic configurations of homonuclear diatomic molecules, the concept of bond order, bond length and bond energy. Elementary idea of metallic bonding, hydrogen bonding and its applications

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Internal energy, enthalpy, heat capacity, Hess's law, standard enthalpies
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Fundamentals of thermodynamics: System and surroundings, extensive and intensive properties, state functions, entropy, types of processes. The first law of thermodynamics - Concept of work, heat, internal energy and enthalpy, heat capacity, molar heat capacity, Hess’s law of constant heat summation, Enthalpies of bond dissociation, combustion, formation, atomization, sublimation, phase transition, hydration, ionization and solution

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Entropy, Gibbs free energy criteria, equilibrium constant
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: The second law of thermodynamics - Spontaneity of processes, Delta S of the universe and Delta G of the system as criteria for spontaneity. Delta G° (Standard Gibbs energy change) and equilibrium constant

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Concentration expressions, vapour pressure, ideal and non-ideal solutions
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Different methods for expressing the concentration of solution - molality, molarity, mole fraction, percentage (by volume and mass both), the vapour pressure of solutions and Raoult's Law - Ideal and non-ideal solutions, vapour pressure - composition, plots for ideal and non-ideal solutions

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Elevation of boiling point, depression of freezing point, osmotic pressure, van't Hoff factor
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Colligative properties of dilute solutions - a relative lowering of vapour pressure, depression of freezing point, the elevation of boiling point and osmotic pressure, determination of molecular mass using colligative properties, abnormal value of molar mass, van’t Hoff factor and its significance

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Dynamic equilibrium, Kp and Kc, Le Chatelier's principle
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Meaning of equilibrium is the concept of dynamic equilibrium. Equilibria involving physical processes: Solid-liquid, liquid-gas, gas-gas and solid-gas equilibria, Henry's law. General characteristics of equilibrium involving physical processes. Equilibrium involving chemical processes: Law of chemical equilibrium, equilibrium constants (Kp and Kc) and their significance, the significance of Delta G and Delta G° in chemical equilibrium, factors affecting equilibrium concentration, pressure, temperature, the effect of catalyst, Le Chatelier’s principle

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Acids, bases, pH scale, salt hydrolysis, solubility product, buffer solutions
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Ionic equilibrium: Weak and strong electrolytes, ionization of electrolytes, various concepts of acids and bases (Arrhenius, Bronsted - Lowry and Lewis) and their ionization, acid-base equilibria (including multistage ionization) and ionization constants, ionization of water, pH scale, common ion effect, hydrolysis of salts and pH of their solutions, the solubility of sparingly soluble salts, solubility products and buffer solutions

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Oxidation numbers and redox balancing
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Electronic concepts of oxidation and reduction, redox reactions, oxidation number, rules for assigning oxidation number and balancing of redox reactions

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Electrolytic conduction, molar conductivities, Kohlrausch's law
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Electrolytic and metallic conduction, conductance in electrolytic solutions, molar conductivities and their variation with concentration, Kohlrausch’s law and its applications

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Galvanic cells, standard potentials, Nernst equation, batteries
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Electrochemical cells - Electrolytic and Galvanic cells, different types of electrodes, electrode potentials including standard electrode potential, half-cell and cell reactions, emf of a Galvanic cell and its measurement, Nernst equation and its applications, relationship between cell potential and Gibbs' energy change, dry cell and lead accumulator, fuel cells

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Order and molecularity, zero and first order integrated equations, half-life
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Rate of a chemical reaction, factors affecting the rate of reactions: concentration, temperature, pressure and catalyst, elementary and complex reactions, order and molecularity of reactions, rate law, rate constant and its units, differential and integral forms of zero and first-order reactions, their characteristics and half-lives

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Arrhenius equation, activation energy, collision theory
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: The effect of temperature on the rate of reactions, Arrhenius theory, activation energy and its calculation, collision theory of bi-molecular gaseous reactions (no derivation)

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_unit_title: CLASSIFICATION OF ELEMENTS AND PERIODICITY IN PROPERTIES
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Modern periodic law, periodic trends in radii, ionization, electron gain, valence
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Modern periodic law and present form of the periodic table, s, p, d and f block elements, periodic trends in properties of elements atomic and ionic radii, ionization enthalpy, electron gain enthalpy, valence, oxidation states and chemical reactivity

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Group 13 to 18 electronic configurations, general trends, anomalous first element
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Group -13 to Group 18 Elements. General Introduction: Electronic configuration and general trends in physical and chemical properties of elements across the periods and down the groups, unique behaviour of the first element in each group

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Trends in properties, catalytic, magnetic, interstitial, alloys, K2Cr2O7 and KMnO4
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Transition Elements - General introduction, electronic configuration, occurrence and characteristics, general trends in properties of the first-row transition elements - physical properties, ionization enthalpy, oxidation states, atomic radii, colour, catalytic behaviour, magnetic properties, complex formation, interstitial compounds, alloy formation, preparation, properties and uses of K2Cr2O7 and KMnO4

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Lanthanoids and Actinoids, oxidation states, Lanthanoid contraction
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Inner Transition Elements. Lanthanoids - Electronic configuration, oxidation states and Lanthanoid contraction. Actinoids - Electronic configuration and oxidation states

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Werner's theory, ligands, IUPAC nomenclature, isomerism, VBT, CFT
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Introduction to coordination compounds. Werner's theory, ligands, coordination number, denticity, chelation, IUPAC nomenclature of mononuclear co-ordination compounds, isomerism, Bonding: Valence bond approach and basic ideas of Crystal field theory, colour and magnetic properties, importance of coordination compounds (in qualitative analysis, extraction of metals and in biological systems)

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_unit_title: PURIFICATION AND CHARACTERISATION OF ORGANIC COMPOUNDS
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Crystallization, sublimation, distillation, differential extraction, chromatography
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Purification - Crystallization, sublimation, distillation, differential extraction and chromatography - principles and their applications

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_unit_title: PURIFICATION AND CHARACTERISATION OF ORGANIC COMPOUNDS
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Detection and estimation of C, H, N, S, P, halogens, empirical formula
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Qualitative analysis - Detection of nitrogen, sulphur, phosphorus and halogens. Quantitative analysis (basic principles only) - Estimation of carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen, halogens, sulphur and phosphorus. Calculations of empirical formulae and molecular formulae, numerical problems in organic quantitative analysis

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_unit_title: SOME BASIC PRINCIPLES OF ORGANIC CHEMISTRY
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: IUPAC nomenclature, structural and stereoisomerism
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Tetravalency of carbon, shapes of simple molecules - hybridization (s and p): classification of organic compounds based on functional groups and those containing halogens, oxygen, nitrogen and sulphur, homologous series: Isomerism - structural and stereoisomerism. Nomenclature (Trivial and IUPAC)

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_unit_title: SOME BASIC PRINCIPLES OF ORGANIC CHEMISTRY
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Bond fission, carbocations, free radicals, inductive, electromeric, resonance, hyperconjugation
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Covalent bond fission - Homolytic and heterolytic, free radicals, carbocations and carbanions, stability of carbocations and free radicals, electrophiles and nucleophiles. Electronic displacement in a covalent bond - Inductive effect, electromeric effect, resonance and hyperconjugation. Common types of organic reactions- Substitution, addition, elimination and rearrangement

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Conformations (Sawhorse, Newman) and halogenation mechanism
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Classification, isomerism, IUPAC nomenclature, general methods of preparation, properties and reactions. Alkanes - Conformations: Sawhorse and Newman projections (of ethane), mechanism of halogenation of alkanes

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Electrophilic addition, Markovnikov rule, peroxide effect, ozonolysis, polymerization, acidity of alkynes
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Alkenes - Geometrical isomerism, mechanism of electrophilic addition, addition of hydrogen, halogens, water, hydrogen halides (Markownikoffs and peroxide effect), Ozonolysis and polymerization. Alkynes - Acidic character, addition of hydrogen, halogens, water and hydrogen halides, polymerization

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Benzene aromaticity, electrophilic substitution, Friedel-Crafts, directive influence
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Aromatic hydrocarbons - Nomenclature, benzene - structure and aromaticity, mechanism of electrophilic substitution, halogenation, nitration. Friedel-Craft's alkylation and acylation, directive influence of the functional group in mono-substituted benzene

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: C-X bond nature, substitution mechanisms (SN1, SN2), polyhalogen compounds
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: General methods of preparation, properties and reactions, nature of C-X bond, mechanisms of substitution reactions. Uses, environmental effects of chloroform, iodoform, freons and DDT

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Alcohol dehydration, phenol electrophilic substitution, Reimer-Tiemann, ether structure
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: General methods of preparation, properties, reactions and uses. ALCOHOLS, PHENOLS AND ETHERS. Alcohols: Identification of primary, secondary and tertiary alcohols, mechanism of dehydration. Phenols: Acidic nature, electrophilic substitution reactions, halogenation, nitration and sulphonation, Reimer - Tiemann reaction. Ethers: Structure

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Carbonyl nucleophilic addition, Aldol, Cannizzaro, Haloform, reduction reactions
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Aldehyde and Ketones: Nature of carbonyl group, nucleophilic addition to >C=O group, relative reactivities of aldehydes and ketones, important reactions such as - Nucleophilic addition reactions (addition of HCN, NH3 and its derivatives), Grignard reagent, oxidation, reduction (Wolf Kishner and Clemmensen), the acidity of alpha-hydrogen. Aldol condensation, Cannizzaro reaction, Haloform reaction, chemical tests to distinguish between aldehydes and ketones

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Acidity and factors affecting acid strength
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Carboxylic Acids: Acidic strength and factors affecting it

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Classification, structure, basicity, identification of 1o, 2o, 3o amines
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: General methods of preparation, properties, reactions and uses. Amines: Nomenclature, classification, structure, basic character and identification of primary, secondary and tertiary amines and their basic character

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Synthetic importance and reactions
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Diazonium Salts: Importance in synthetic organic chemistry

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Classification, aldoses, ketoses, monosaccharides, oligosaccharides
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: General introduction and importance of biomolecules. CARBOHYDRATES – Classification, aldoses and ketoses, monosaccharides (glucose and fructose) and constituent monosaccharides of oligosaccharides (sucrose, lactose and maltose)

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Amino acids, peptide bonds, protein structures, denaturation, enzymes
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: PROTEINS - Elementary idea of alpha-amino acids, peptide bond, polypeptides, proteins: primary, secondary, tertiary and quaternary structure (qualitative idea only), denaturation of proteins, enzymes

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Classification, DNA/RNA chemical constitution and biological functions, hormones
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: VITAMINS – Classification and functions. NUCLEIC ACIDS – Chemical constitution of DNA and RNA, biological functions of nucleic acids. Hormones (General introduction)

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_topic: Detection of Elements and Functional Groups
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Extra elements (N, S, halogens) and functional groups detection
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Detection of extra elements (Nitrogen, sulphur, halogens) in organic compounds, detection of the following functional groups, hydroxyl (alcoholic and phenolic), carbonyl (aldehyde and ketones) carboxyl and amino groups in organic compounds

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Inorganic (Mohr's salt, potash alum) and organic preparations
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: The chemistry involved in the preparation of the following: Inorganic compounds, Mohr’s salt, potash alum. Organic compounds: Acetanilide, p-nitro acetanilide, aniline yellow, iodoform

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Acid-base titrations and KMnO4 redox titrations
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: The chemistry involved in the titrimetric exercises – acids, bases and the use of indicators, oxalic-acid vs KMnO4, Mohr’s salt vs KMnO4

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Cation and anion detection and chemical principles
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Chemical principles involved in the qualitative salt analysis: Cations – Pb2+, Cu2+, Al3+, Fe3+, Zn2+, Ni2+, Ca2+, Ba2+, Mg2+, NH4+; Anions – CO3 2-, S 2-, SO4 2-, NO3 -, NO2 -, Cl -, Br -, I - (Insoluble salts excluded)

syllabus_items.subject: chemistry
syllabus_items.official_subtopic: Enthalpy, lyophilic/lyophobic sols, and reaction kinetics
syllabus_items.official_scope_text: Chemical principles involved in the following experiments: 1. Enthalpy of solution of CuSO4; 2. Enthalpy of neutralization of strong acid and strong base; 3. Preparation of lyophilic and lyophobic sols; 4. Kinetic study of the reaction of iodide ions with hydrogen peroxide at room temperature
